title: Explicit Semantic Readout Capability Gate
goal: Add an explicit capability gate, caller identity requirement, governed capsule requirement, structured boundary telemetry, and zero-retry default to the optional semantic readout path while preserving the deterministic local fallback.

core_rule.statement: Network semantic readout must remain explicitly gated by capability, backend selection, model identity, endpoint permission, caller identity, and governed capsule provenance; deterministic local readout remains the default fallback.
core_rule.effect: Environment variables alone do not authorize network inference, and the optional boundary remains bounded by local fallback.

problem_statement.current_state: The semantic readout boundary can reach a network backend when the backend is selected, but the code does not yet require an explicit capability flag, caller identity, or governed context capsule before attempting network inference.
problem_statement.gap: The boundary is not yet hard-gated against implicit activation from environment variables alone, and it does not yet emit a structured authorization record for attempted, denied, successful, failed, and fallback outcomes.
problem_statement.risk: An optional network path can become an unmeasured inference sink unless its authorization and telemetry are explicit.

basis.scope: Harden the optional semantic readout boundary without changing the deterministic local reply path or introducing automatic retries.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the explicit network capability flag, authorization predicate, structured reply helper, capsule validation, zero-retry default, and structured boundary telemetry while preserving the deterministic local fallback.
Declare the network capability flag as disabled by default and record the permitted endpoint list and retry budget explicitly.

runtime_changes.authorization_predicate: enable_network_semantic_readout AND explicit network backend selection AND nonempty model id AND permitted endpoint AND credential present AND caller identity present AND valid governed capsule present
runtime_changes.fallback_policy: Return the deterministic local reply when the network boundary is denied or the network call fails.
runtime_changes.retry_policy: No automatic retry; retry budget defaults to zero and requires a separate governed policy before changing.

acceptance_criteria: Default shipped configuration does not attempt network semantic readout.
Environment variables alone do not activate the network boundary.
A missing caller identity or governed capsule denies the network boundary.
A permitted network failure falls back to the deterministic local reply.
Structured telemetry is emitted for attempted, denied, successful, failed, and fallback outcomes.
The deterministic local reply path remains the default fallback.
